title: Three-valued `AND`, `OR`, `NOT`, `IN`; `bool_and`, `bool_or` skip NULLs
description: `NULL AND FALSE` is false, `NULL OR TRUE` true, `NULL AND TRUE`, `NULL OR FALSE`, `NOT NULL` and `NULL = NULL` NULL. `1 IN (1, NULL)` is true, `NULL IN (1, NULL)` and `2 NOT IN (1, NULL)` NULL.
`bool_and` and `bool_or` skip NULLs: over (TRUE, NULL) both are true, over (FALSE, NULL) both false; over NULLs only or no rows both are NULL.
reference: `and`, `or`, `not` and comparisons are Kleene's; aggregates skip NULLs and are NULL over no values (reference-semantics.md, NULL and Aggregates).
